app.name: PureKnowledge
app.description: Capture notes, curate wiki pages, and connect knowledge to suite resources.

tools.name: getKnowledgeContext
tools.description: Call this first: compact context for the knowledge base — active space and page, every space with its page count, wiki/note totals, and the store path. Ground page and space references here before using the other tools.

tools.name: searchKnowledge
tools.description: Search the knowledge base across titles, aliases, tags, page bodies, slugs, wikilinks, and resource links — the same ranking the sidebar search uses. Empty query lists the most recently updated pages plus the space overview. getKnowledgeContext names the active space.

space.description: Limit results to one space, by id or name. listSpaces names them.

tools.name: readKnowledgePage
tools.description: Read one knowledge page in full by id, slug, title, or alias. getKnowledgeContext and searchKnowledge supply the references.

tools.name: listSpaces
tools.description: List knowledge spaces with page counts and which is active.

tools.name: getBacklinks
tools.description: List the pages whose bodies wikilink to one page. Read before a rename, merge, or delete — these are the pages the change ripples through.

tools.name: listKnowledgeActivity
tools.description: Recent knowledge-base activity, newest first: page edits, promotions, link additions, and agent writes, with the human or agent actor. Optionally scoped to one page.

tools.name: reviewKnowledge
tools.description: Curation sweep over a space: broken wikilinks, orphan pages, stale pages, and duplicate titles. Read-only — apply the fixes worth making with applyKnowledgeChange; destructive ones at the user's direction.

tools.name: applyKnowledgeChange
tools.description: Write a change to the wiki directly: create a page, update, rename, promote a note to wiki, merge into another page, or delete. Body is markdown; [[Page name]] creates wikilinks. importAssets copies up to 100 local images into the package and appends portable inline Markdown. Every write is recorded in the agent log with before/after and in the suite operations ledger. Call getKnowledgeContext first to ground the space and page.

body.description: Page Markdown. Required for create/update unless importAssets supplies the new content; an asset-only update appends to the existing body.

action.description: What to write. Defaults to update when page names an existing page, create otherwise. rename needs the new title; promote turns a note into a wiki page; merge needs into (the surviving page) and body (its merged content); delete removes the page (and its children).

into.description: merge only: the surviving page (id, slug, title, or alias) the page merges into.

links.description: Resource links to attach on accept: files, app resources, or URLs the page concerns.

importAssets.description: Local images to copy into the knowledge package and append inline to body. Each copied image is also recorded as a file link. Supported: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG.

sourcePath.description: Absolute path to a local image outside or inside the package.

alt.description: Accessible image description; defaults to the source filename.

tools.name: listKnowledgeChanges
tools.description: The agent log: recent agent writes to the wiki, newest first, with change type, actor, and summary. Check before repeating work another agent already did.

tools.name: personalAssistantMemory
tools.description: Read durable memories under the Personal assistant root, or remember a fact the user asked to retain. Creates the root in the active collection if needed. Updates require expectedUpdatedAt from a read. Saves normally, records before/after, returns actual page paths. No credentials.

tools.name: readPersonalAssistantMemory
tools.description: Read a bounded overview of durable facts under the Personal assistant root, with page identities, revisions and paths. No writes. Use readKnowledgePage to read full pages when needed.
